script: When a coworker exploded over a single energy drink, everything shattered.. The vendor sent us a fresh 24‑pack of this new energy drink to taste‑test before we could sell it. Management dumped the whole pack at the desk, like any other freebie. People grabbed a few, put them in the fridge with the lunch boxes, no big deal. Bert—our manager who can't even keep a desk tidy without a nap—snagged ten of those bottles, stashed them in his car, and planned to pocket the rest when his shift ended. I didn't care; there were still a handful left in the fridge and I am not about to let a lazy manager steal my snacks. I cracked open one on my first shift back. An hour later, my coworker—let's call her Jess—went full‑on drama. She swore I'd "chewed out" her and that I'd snatched the last two bottles that were supposedly "saved for Bert." She acted like I was a thief. I told her, "Bruh, we were all told these were for everyone." She didn't budge. She kept saying that if Bert already took ten, why should I be the only one to feel guilty about a free energy drink? She's not wrong—everyone deserves a sip. But she's ignoring the fact that the vendor, the GM, and even the guest who gave us the 12‑pack of Coke all said these drinks were for the whole crew. No one said "Bert only." I didn't even know he'd taken the bulk. She's basically judging me for not knowing the unwritten rule that didn't exist. Jess also took three boxes of snacks home that a guest handed out with the drinks. I am not sure if she's trying to prove a point or just showing off. Either way, I am like, "Bro, if you're going to be a judge, at least know the facts before you start throwing shade." So yeah, I got chewed out over a free energy drink. I am not the one who stole ten bottles, and I wasn't told the last ones were a secret Bert stash. I just wanted to grab a quick boost and it turned into a full‑blown episode of "Who stole the energy drink?" The only thing I learned is that next time I'll double‑check who actually owns the freebies before I open 'em.
